summary: Command timeout defaults to 30 seconds (was 10); raise it globally with ANSIBLE_PERSISTENT_COMMAND_TIMEOUT or command_timeout, or per task, since some modules have a timeout option distinct from the task keyword.
questions: How do I fix command timeout triggered?
How do I increase the command timeout globally?
Is a module's timeout option the same as the task timeout keyword?

answer_card.title: Increase command timeout
answer_card.answer_md:
Global:
```shell
export ANSIBLE_PERSISTENT_COMMAND_TIMEOUT=60
```
```ini
[persistent_connection]
command_timeout = 60
```
Per task: many network modules accept a `timeout` option, which is not the same as the task-level `timeout` keyword. Default is 30 seconds (older versions used 10).
